svg.text: Grey = actual IFC Body · Black = current geometry-derived review proxy · Blue = official-DWG review reference
solid blue = mechanically selected native 2D DWG paths

foreignObject.div: Official independent 2D DWG; mechanically selected native 180×200 Plan/Front/Side linework. The prior ACIS-solid envelope is superseded and excluded from approval.
Native 2D paths remain 1:1 and receive translation only. The official 2100×2520×900 mm-labelled configuration does not exactly match the project Body; no fit or scaling is applied.
